record_facts.existing_use_text: Existing Restaurant in a 2,008 sq ft ground-floor commercial unit (d.b.a. Mona Lisa Mare e Monti since February 2022; previously The US Restaurant through January 2022), operating with an ABC Type 41 licence. unsure: floor_area_before_sqft / floor_area_sqft: the motion is inconsistent. Finding 3 says the theatre totals 23,488 sq ft; finding 6.B uses 24,138 gross sq ft for the floor area ratio; finding 6.C says the 'current floor area' is 24,488 gross sq ft and the addition adds 325. The plan sheet's gross square footage table has existing levels summing to 23,488 and proposed levels summing to 24,138 (a delta of 325 shown at both basement and orchestra levels, 650 in all; the sums are my arithmetic). Recorded 23,488 before and 24,138 after; on finding 6.C's figures it would be 24,488 before and 24,813 after. Every version is far above the 4,000 sq ft limit and shows an increase.
business_type: recorded 'other' (a movie theatre and live-entertainment venue). The project also establishes a Bar use, so 'bar' is an arguable reading.

amplified_sound: the motion never says 'amplified sound will be used'; it says no electronic amplification is proposed between midnight and 6 a.m. and describes live music and acoustic retrofits. Recorded true on that basis.
closing_hour: null. The motion says only that the venue 'will not be open between two a.m. and six a.m.'; no closing or opening hour is given.
licence_type, licences_already_held, alcohol_transaction: not in the motion (triggers.json: 'Licence type not in the motion'); condition 6 says ABC permits 'may be required'.

seats: null. The plans show existing seat counts (ground floor 802, loge 156, balcony 474) and a 'proposed seat count range: 520 - 540' for the seated ground-floor layout; the motion states no total and the floor also converts to standing events.

story: the motion says first and second stories (the second being the mezzanine / balcony per triggers.json); the basement is used for dressing rooms and a restroom, not listed here as a story of the use.

changes_existing_business: the Movie Theater stays and the project adds floor area (enlarge) and new entertainment and bar uses (intensify). In code terms the record treats the new uses as new uses plus a change of a nonconforming use (§ 182), not as a § 178 intensification.
Second-story Nighttime Entertainment and the addition were not permitted at filing; approval was contingent on a later code amendment (condition 6). That is a control fact, not a profile fact.
